notes: v6.4.3 - Field fixes from real use: (1) Text Animations can no longer leave your text black or stuck hidden - every animation now settles back to your text's own look at the end. (2) The Song Finder file picker actually shows your videos now (a filter bug hid every file). (3) Find the song responds instantly, hears short videos whole, and never hangs without a word. (4) SFX Trending shows Loading and its results right in the list. (5) Blue Emoji colour variants keep their transparent background - before, they came out as a face on a black square. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
